searchText: Are there any client teams that are Syncing on sunnyside devnet how many validators do you guys run per host? Perhaps <@1349892533454635109> or <@1349842134546649172> have some insight. One of us can debug further and see what comes up. Really good question <@288990561279541248> Every other node in the devnet has 100 validators per host. But for some reason, i just realized that lodestar nodes have no validator attached. Should I put some validators on the node and see if the behavior changes? yes although that will not explain the behavior you are seeing above... there should def be a bandwidth difference with less columns being gossiped oh interesting, with no validators the supernode should indeed use more bw than a full node :/ if you had a lot of validators connected then both would use the same (validator custody requirements) yea they're both using the lower end of the bandwidth (with the odd numbered node being supernode) I'll add the validators to the node <@1351272205555863614> would you mind adding my keys to the Lodestar sunnyside boxes so i can SSH in to look through the logs? https://github.com/testinprod-io/ethereum-devnets/blob/27c86616c5a1931e3537e33dd9086e658dfb8c5e/ansible/inventories/peerdas-devnet-ssl-15/group_vars/lodestar.yaml#L8 https://github.com/matthewkeil.keys Added! can you check acces now? Lodestar <> Prysm re: specifically why the bandwidth is similar between full nodes and supernodes, I suspect it might be because lodestar subscribes to all column subnets regardless of column custody ([PR here](https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/7607), <@931591385545584640> if this makes sense). By "using the lower end of the bandwidth" do you mean they're averaging less bandwidth than other nodes? That's a really good point. I forgot that we didn't merge that yet Where you can definitely see a difference would be in db size Yea, the [bandwidth usage is closer to the other full nodes](http://94.130.19.237:3000/d/dsfasdfasf/network-monitor?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now&timezone=utc&var-network=peerdas-devnet-ssl-15&var-consensus=$__all&var-execution=$__all&refresh=1m&var-group_by=supernode,consensus_client&viewPanel=panel-29) in the network (nimbus-geth-1/lodestar-reth-1 is supernode, but lodestar uses less bandwidth) The db size is also similar with lodestar-geth-1 and 2 using `16G` and `13G` respectively. I've added new validators to the deposit queue, so I'll monitor it over the weekend and see if the behavior changes in any way
